title: Customer Success - Team Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

16 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.

CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.

Location: This is a globally remote role

The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, helping publishers maximize revenue by building strong, transparent, and diversified demand partnerships. We work with leading DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, and agencies worldwide to create a more competitive auction environment that drives higher fill rates and stronger returns for publishers across web, app, and CTV. This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to drastically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand‑Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply‑Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partners.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and session RPMs, CPMs for our publishers’ inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities
  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top‑tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high‑level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non‑Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from non‑Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers’ inventories by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.
  • Technical Integration & Operational Oversight – Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary header bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low‑latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high‑growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on‑time and continue to ensure that we do not have issues paying our publisher payments are always received on‑time.
  • Integration Process Management: Work closely with our ad ops and engineering teams to optimize and manage the technical onboarding lifecycle process, including seamless communication between ad ops and demand partner setup on new publishers, from initial testing to full launch and optimization.
  • Communication & Reporting – High‑Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem including header bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator & Financial Acumen: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to solve problems, initiate partnerships via cold outreach, negotiate and present to senior leader, executive‑level contacts.
  • Organization: Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Bonus Qualifications (A Major Plus)
  • Deep DSP Network: Existing contacts and relationships with key decision‑makers at The Trade Desk or other major DSPs and SSPs/Trading Desks.
  • Trade Desk Experience: Previous employment experience at The Trade Desk or a similar Tier‑1 DSP.
  • Global Focus: Experience managing demand partners and monetization across diverse international markets (EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

title: Gestor de Negócios I - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Viveo Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Gestor de Negócios I - Rio de Janeiro role at Viveo

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim! Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.000 colaboradores diretos.

Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.

Empresas do Ecossistema:

  • Indústrias de produtos de higiene, cuidados pessoais e primeiros socorros com marcas fortes e liderança de mercado no varejo nacional: Cremer, Flexicotton e Fell Clean.
  • Empresas que realizam a distribuição do canal hospitalar: Mafra Hospitalar.
  • Empresas que realizam a distribuição do canal de laboratórios e clínicas: Tecnocold e Prevena.
  • Empresas que produzem produtos voltados para nutrição parenteral e soluções estéreis: Insuma (Life, FAMAP, Pró Infusion e Nutrifica).
  • Empresa que realiza a nossa frota, logística e armazenagem de materiais e medicamentos: Health Log.
  • No atendimento à pessoa física possuímos: Mafra Especialidades e Humânia.

Promovemos e disseminamos a Diversidade e Inclusão em todo ecossistema Viveo, conscientizando nossos(as) colaboradores(as) com ações no Pilar LGBTQIA+ (SerQuemSou), Pilar Raça (NaRaça), Pilar Gênero (emPoderAEla) e Pilar Pessoa com Deficiência (SuperAção).

Por isso, buscamos para os nossos times pessoas que sejam protagonistas em transformação de vidas, independente de sexo, raça, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou orientação sexual.

Faça parte do maior ecossistema de saúde do Brasil!

Vem com a gente cuidar de cada vida e unir-se conosco na responsabilidade de criar futuros mais saudáveis!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar venda para clientes definidos em carteira pela sua liderança direta;
  • Acompanhar o atingimento de metas dos seus clientes afim de alcançar os objetivos da empresa através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa (sistemas, relatórios);
  • Visitar frequentemente seus clientes garantindo nível de serviço, atendimento diferenciado e um bom relacionamento;
  • Lançar os pedidos dos seus clientes, acompanhar o pós-vendas e elaborar propostas para aumento de volume e introdução de mix;
  • Implantar ações comerciais (como: descontos e ações de trademarketing) de acordo com as regras definidas pelos seus responsáveis e reportando as situações fora da política aprovação do Gerente Regional e Nacional de Vendas;
  • Aplicar treinamentos periodicamente para seus clientes e participar de feiras e convenções que são relevantes para o seu negócio;
  • Realizar o planejamento de vendas dos seus clientes, com o foco em realizá-lo com máxima assertividade;
  • Entender os processos das áreas que possuem interface com o Comercial (como: suporte, planejamento, produção, marketing,regulatório, recursos humanos) e interagir com as mesmas de forma construtiva e colaborativa com intuito de desenvolver o negócio;
  • Atualizar-se constantemente sobre processos e políticas comerciais (como: digitação de pedidos, faturamento, tabela de preços,forecast);
  • Desempenhar atividades de acordo com as normas da companhia, seu código de ética e de segurança da informação;
  • Construção de JBPs.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo;
  • Vivência com canal farma Indireto, em especial com o Grupo Profarma;
  • Vivência na gestão de grandes contas regionais (Drogarias Venancio, A Nossa Drogaria, Drog. Retiro, Drog. Moderna e Rio Farma).
  • Conhecimento da ferramenta IQVIA para construção de planos de regionais e gerenciamento e médio e longo prazo;
  • Perfil estratégico e proativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Domínio do pacote office (excel e Power Point).

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Vale refeição/vale alimentação;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • PPR;Vale transporte;
  • Centro de Saúde;
  • TotalPass;
  • Parcerias com diversas instituições com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Valores

Descrição Da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro de Contratos e Materiais Júnior para atuar na área de Manutenção Industrial, com foco na gestão de materiais, contratos e suporte ao planejamento de grandes intervenções. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir o fluxo adequado de materiais e serviços, apoiar o controle orçamentário da área e assegurar a conformidade documental dos processos.

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.

Overview

Ready to start your career in quality management within the maritime industry? We're looking for a Junior Quality Analyst to support our management system in a company that provides maritime navigation support services. In this role, you'll work with different procedures and processes, contribute to the continuous improvement of our quality management system, and gradually build expertise in compliance with international standards and codes. You'll also support audits, assist in documenting processes, and collaborate closely with other departments to ensure efficiency and compliance.

What We Offer

At Maersk Supply Service, you'll be part of a leading organization dedicated to providing safe, reliable, and efficient marine solutions to the energy sector. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you'll join a dynamic team of professionals across operations, technical, commercial, supply chain, HSE, finance, and HR, each bringing expertise to navigate the complexities of our industry. We believe our diversity is a vital strength, and we encourage you to bring your unique insights to help shape the future of our team and our company. We are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Assist in preparing documents related to the management system.
  • Check the progress of all non-conformity reports (NCRs) issued on the project.
  • Participate in internal, customer, and subcontractor meetings, contributing ideas and suggestions for improvements.
  • Provide support to lead auditors in audits (internal and subcontractors).
  • Support the dissemination of a positive quality culture among all project stakeholders.
  • Collect lessons learned and submit them to the Quality Manager for analysis.
  • Monitor performance indicators.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or a closely related field.
  • Knowledge of document and record control.
  • Experience with ISO systems and auditing.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese, both written and spoken.
  • Solid experience with Microsoft Office Suite.
How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than October 15th. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Nathan Giraldes via email.

Working Conditions

This is a full-time, permanent position based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and reporting to the Sr HSEQ Manager. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the process will be closed when the right candidate is found; thus, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Empregador: Full Tec Engenharia – Full Tec Engenharia é uma empresa inovadora e em constante crescimento, especializada em reformas de teatros e gestão de obras cênicas.

Cargo: Coordenador de Obras Sênior em Construção Civil – Local de Trabalho: Sede – Niterói/RJ.

Resumo: Buscamos profissional de Engenharia Civil com experiência em executar obras, apaixonado pela área e deseja desenvolver habilidades em ambiente dinâmico.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Planejar, organizar e controlar todas as atividades de execução de obras civis no canteiro, alinhando-se ao cronograma global do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de obra, trabalhadores, encarregados, engenheiros e subcontratados, promovendo integração, motivação e desenvolvimento das competências técnicas.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o cronograma de execução, realizando ajustes necessários para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Gerenciar recursos materiais, equipamentos e mão de obra, promovendo eficiência operacional e economia.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho, licenças ambientais, normas técnicas (ABNT, ASTM, etc.) e políticas internas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, como produtividade, desperdício, qualidade e segurança, propondo ações corretivas.
  • Controlar a documentação técnica, registros, relatórios diários e demais registros do andamento da obra.
  • Fiscalizar a execução técnica, verificando se os trabalhos estão de acordo com os projetos, especificações e normativas.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros, garantindo a entrega de materiais e serviços conforme o cronograma.
  • Realizar reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento junto às equipes e stakeholders.
  • Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de obras, com foco em eficiência, segurança e sustentabilidade.
Requisitos
  • Residir no RIO DE JANEIRO.
  • Formação superior em Engenharia Civil ou correlatas.
  • Possuir no mínimo 15 anos de experiência em obras de Construção civil abrangentes e generalista.
  • Experiência sólida na coordenação de obras de construção civil, preferencialmente em obras de grande porte ou de alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas construtivas, gestão de cronogramas, custos, produtividade e controle de qualidade.
  • Familiaridade com legislação e normas técnicas aplicáveis à construção civil (ABNT, NBR, NR, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de obras e softwares de controle (MS Project, AutoCAD, ERP, etc.).
  • Perfil de liderança, capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação eficiente e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares de forma motivadora.
  • Estar disponível para viagens.
Diferenciais
  • Pós-graduação, especializações na área de Gestão de Obras ou Engenharia de Produção.
  • Certificações como PMP, Lean Construction, Six Sigma ou similares.
  • Inglês técnico.
  • Experiência com obras sustentáveis ou certificados ambientais.
Remuneração

Á combinar entre as partes e de acordo com a forma de contratação pactuada, e experiência.

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward‑thinking environment.

title: LATAM Plan Approval Engineer
description:
RINA is currently recruiting for a LATAM Plan Approval Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the Latin America Marine Division.

Mission

This role focuses on supporting the elaboration of detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met.

Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities
  • Review and approve drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phases, providing guidance and support on technical matters in line with RINA Rules, international conventions, and contractual requirements.
  • Support the resolution of issues related to conflicting design requirements, materials, and standards.
  • Prepare project deliverables (technical reports, approval documentation, engineering drawings, etc.).
  • Manage assigned tasks with ownership and accountability for technical quality, delivery, and financial progress.
  • Support or manage simple projects applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and clients to facilitate the plan approval process and address technical concerns.
Qualifications
  • Active CREA registration required.
  • 1 year of experience in the marine engineering field, particularly with maritime systems or in a technical consultancy environment.
  • Solid understanding of regulations and standards (e.g., NORMAM, SOLAS, MARPOL, Class Rules) for ships.
  • Knowledge of plan approval processes within the maritime industry, ensuring compliance with regulatory bodies and international standards.
  • Ability to collaborate with internal teams and clients to facilitate the approval process and address technical concerns.
  • Proficiency in creating detailed reports and documentation, outlining compliance status, technical findings, and recommendations for approval.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proactive attitude, attention to detail, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Familiarity with engineering software tools in each related area.
For Hull / Stability background:
  • Bachelor's degree in Naval Engineering.
  • Experience in structural design, hull arrangements, or stability of ships or offshore units.
  • Familiarity with Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis tools or stability analysis tools (NAPA, Maxsurf, GHS, etc.).
  • Understanding of classification rules for hull structure, stability, and materials.
  • Knowledge of relevant international conventions (SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line, etc.).
For Machinery background:
  • Bachelor's degree in Naval or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience with machinery systems on board ships, including propulsion, auxiliary systems, piping, HVAC, or control systems.
  • Understanding of machinery arrangements and compliance with Class and Statutory requirements (SOLAS, MARPOL, NORMAM).
  • Familiarity with P&ID review, system design evaluation, and mechanical components selection.
  • Ability to assess system layouts and resolve technical issues related to machinery integration.
For Electrical background:
  • Bachelor's degree in Naval, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience with electrical and automation systems on ships, including power generation, distribution, and propulsion.
  • Knowledge of Class and Statutory standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, IEC, NORMAM).

A Stone

Nossa Cultura

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Logística - Atendimento Ativo (Recuperação de Terminais) | HUNTER ANGEL:

Conhecido como Hunter Angels, esse time tem a missão de reduzir a quantidade de perdas de máquinas e aumentar a eficiência da cadeia logística, gerando rentabilidade para a companhia.

Para isso, a sua rotina é realizar atendimento ativo aos clientes por meio de telefone e, quando necessário, em múltiplos canais para recuperação dos terminais (maquininhas) que estão em clientes inativos.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer - L3 Support to…

…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify issues, prioritize them, and coordinate remediation.

This is an engineering-focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of Python engineers working remotely in global locations

Who you are

  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about agile software development
  • You love leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers - especially Python ones
  • You are knowledgeable in cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You are comfortable administrating Linux servers, including their storage and networking
  • You have hands-on experience with software automation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver high-quality software in a timely manner
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Having a thorough understanding of modern infrastructure, including OpenStack or Kubernetes
  • Having experience in operations as well as software development
  • Being familiar with the challenges of large-scale, multi-cloud operations
  • Go expertise

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers

All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.

Location: This role will be based remotely.

What your day will look like

  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.

What we are looking for in you

The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:

  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. description:
OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect M/FGeneral information

OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect M/F

As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. Backed by the AFM Group, a globallyrecognized, family-owned investment group, we benefit from long-term stabilityand a shared commitment to sustainable growth.

By the end of 2024, our operational and under-construction capacity reached 3.3 gigawatts—a 14% increase since 2023. With 1,500 employees worldwide, we thrive in a fast-moving environment driven by adaptability, innovation, and collaboration.

In our company, your work directly contributes to a more sustainable world. Whether you're driving projects forward, optimizing operations, or leading strategic initiatives, you're contributing to our mission to improve the global environment and foster local development.

At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.

title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counselis responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27.

This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.
Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:
  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.
Additional specific areas of responsibility include:
  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

Overview

Join to apply for the Profissional Engenheiro de Construção Sênior role at Radix.

A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos, e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. A Radix atua no Brasil, com escritório no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, além de filiais nos Estados Unidos, consolidando-se como uma empresa global.

Como Engenheiro(a) Senior de Construção você vai:

Responsibilities
  • Suportar o Líder de Projetos e Gerente nas atividades de Construção, Desconstrução e Montagem.
  • Avaliar e definir estratégias de instalação de novos pacotes/equipamentos (lifting, handling, etc.).
  • Planejar e acompanhar escopos de construção e desconstrução.
  • Identificar, priorizar e mitigar riscos referentes às fases de construção e desconstrução.
  • Avaliar propostas de execução offshore.
  • Avaliar constructabilidade de módulos, skids e pacotes offshore.
  • Participação em Análise de Riscos.
  • Participar de Design review.
Qualifications
  • Nível superior completo em engenharia Mecânica, Produção ou Civil há mais de 10 anos.
  • Experiência prévia em construção em Projetos de Brownfield.
  • Inglês nível avançado (será testado).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no centro do Rio de Janeiro 4x por semana com 1 dia de Home Office.
Competencies
  • Perfil Multitarefa
  • Organização
  • Boa dinâmica para trabalho em equipe
  • Automotivação
  • Proatividade
  • Planejamento
Differentials
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de desenho 2D e 3D
  • Vivência em área de projetos de engenharia multidisciplinar (Conceitual, Básico, Feed e Detalhado)
Benefits
  • Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo)
  • Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes)
  • Vale refeição / alimentação flexível
  • Auxílio home office
  • Day off (no mês do aniversário)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Licença Maternidade (6 meses) e Paternidade (20 dias) estendidas
  • Auxílio creche para filhos de até 3 anos (por filho)
  • Apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz
  • Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa)
  • Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar
  • Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers
  • Planos de incentivos
About The Company

Há 15 anos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio, no Brasil e em Tecnologia... Prazer, Radix. Atuamos na transformação digital de clientes em diversos segmentos, implementamos soluções que tornam os processos mais eficientes e, através de um time altamente especializado e multidisciplinar. Temos atuação global, com projetos em mais de 30 países, para empresas de diferentes tamanhos e setores.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar consultas no pronto atendimento, unificando dados contidos em prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos;
  • Passar em visita aos pacientes internados, avaliando a recuperação dos mesmos;
  • Efetuar pequenas intervenções cirúrgicas que não exijam corpo clínico especializado;

title: Automation Engineer, Electrical
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire an Automation Engineer, Electrical.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair, and maintenance work, including diagnostics, troubleshooting, and repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment, as well as electrical and control systems, across the MacGregor product range and third-party products, if needed.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e., the US, South and Central America, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to the company standards.

This role is part of our Global Services Division. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent.

What you’ll need to succeed

Your main discipline is automation and software. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have good communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

  • At least 5 years working directly with software and automation;
  • Education within the electrical, control and automation field. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education;
  • Previous experience in the maritime/shipping industry and with shipboard equipment (cranes) is essential.
  • Somatic and electrical components knowledge
  • Ability to write reports and documentation electronically
  • Ability to work with a flexible daily schedule and be available for short-notice travel assignments
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Proficient in English language - both verbal and written
Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional information

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English.

title: Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)
description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador.
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque.
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas.
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente.
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas.
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção.
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas.
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio.
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa.
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores.
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA.
  • Representar eventualmente a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências.
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida.
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho.
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS.
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações.
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Registro no MTE
  • Conhecimento em legislação de segurança do trabalho e normas regulamentadoras (NR)
  • Bons conhecimentos em informática e ferramentas de gestão
  • Habilidade de comunicação e interação com equipes

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia: desconto em medicamentos e produtos diversos para higiene pessoal
  • Alimentação no local
  • GymPass / Seguro de Vida
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas de operação portuária e logística de acordo com os mais elevados padrões de qualidade e segurança, respeito ao indivíduo e ao meio ambiente, agregando máximo valor aos acionistas e à sociedade de forma ética e inovadora.
